category: Branding and wording for each client

history.name: The two typefaces are named per project
history.description: A project names the display face used for titles and feature names and the body face used for prose. Either can be swapped for another the tool carries, and the record's checks say plainly when a chosen face isn't one that can be embedded.
history.dev_notes: brand.fonts.display / .body; adding a face means dropping the static WOFF files in, listing them in FONT_FACES and re-running the coverage script.
